narr: On 6/3, slow moving front resulted in several rounds of thunderstorms across northeast Kansas. This resulted in rainfall amounts of 2 to 6 inches and a few instances of water rescues and street flooding.
ev: Two water rescues occurred from their vehicles east of Garnett.
Street flooding occurring east of Lake Shawnee.
Ditches, yards, and several roads full of water.
High water covering roadways in west Burlington.
Numerous roads closed across the Lyon County, including roads that rarely flood.
Storm Spotter in Burlington reports that Rock Creek is overflowing into several homes.
